work.abstract_text: Extending Jenzer's (2026) same-order and star-family proofs, we resolve his Remark 5.5 (arXiv:2610.21593v1, p. 19): every return permutation satisfies the rotor-loop subset formula for every anticommuting unit bivector family, without the star condition. Conjugation eliminates every off-diagonal scalar contribution except possibly complementary subsets when the family size is odd. Their total vanishes because a balanced product in an exterior algebra has even degree. Corollaries give mixed-sign compact and zero formulas, the exact chain correction, and the range and separability of every return order. For at most three factors the loop has only scalar and simple bivector parts, and every scalar power is a Chebyshev polynomial of its scalar part.

work.title: Permuted rotor loops beyond Jenzer (2026): resolving Remark 5.5 (arXiv:2610.21593v1, p. 19)
